content:
The Apple AirPods Pro 3 were unveiled about a year ago with double the ANC performance, plus improved sound with a wider soundstage and deeper bass compared to the previous generation.
![Apple AirPods Pro 3](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-airpods-pro-3/phone/-159/gsmarena_001.jpg)
![Apple AirPods Pro 3](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-airpods-pro-3/phone/-159/gsmarena_002.jpg)
![Apple AirPods Pro 3](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-airpods-pro-3/phone/-159/gsmarena_003.jpg)
![Apple AirPods Pro 3](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-airpods-pro-3/phone/-159/gsmarena_004.jpg)
Apple AirPods Pro 3
Battery life is 33% better than the Pro 2 buds to boot, lasting up to 8 hours with ANC enabled. The transparency mode (which allows you to hear the world around you) sounds more natural too. And Apple got a certification to enable the Hearing Aid feature in the EU and the UK. There are other neat features like live voice translation.
You can check out our review for a more detailed look at the buds. We found that the AirPods Pro 3 offer great value for money even at MSRP – and they are 32% off MSRP at the moment.
We’ll also mention the AirPods 5, Apple’s mid-range TWS buds. They are on sale too, but with a very small discount that takes them from €150 down to €130. And this is for the model without wireless charging for the case, mind you. The wireless charging option is €17 extra.
The AirPods Pro 3 offer much better sound quality, ANC and battery life – the AirPods 5’s best feature is the lower price. Right now, it’s only a €40 difference (less if you want wireless charging), rather than the usual €100, so we’re leaning towards the Pros.
We may get a commission from qualifying sales.
